label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.calm(); game.step(1); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: help
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); Kit.help.close(); r(JSON.stringify(u)); }, 300))

label: play ready
js: document.querySelector('[data-players="1"]').click(); document.querySelector('[data-level="easy"]').click(); game.start({ level: 'easy', round: 0 }); game.step(0.5); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: brother's stairs
js: game.step(1.2); game.call(); game.step(2.2); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: pops
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); const S = RC.sim; game.quiet(); game.put(0, -5, 0); w.players[0].face = 1; w.critters.push({ id: 801, k: 'walk', x: -0.6, y: 0, hy: 0, dir: 1, ph: 0, st: 'go', t: 0, wait: 9 }); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code:'Space'})); game.step(0.2); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code:'Space'})); game.step(1.2); w.items.forEach(it => { it.x = w.players[0].x; it.y = w.players[0].y; it.t = 1; }); game.step(0.3); w.critters.push({ id: 802, k: 'fly', x: 3, y: -1, hy: -1, dir: 1, ph: 0, st: 'go', t: 0, wait: 0 }); w.water = -0.5; game.step(0.2); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: crack, gem, no room, oops, hurry
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); game.put(0, 0, 0); w.players[0].face = 1; game.step(0.4); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code:'Space'})); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code:'Space'})); game.step(0.4); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code:'ArrowRight'})); game.step(0.4); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code:'ArrowRight'})); w.critters.push({ id: 803, k: 'walk', x: w.players[0].x + 0.2, y: 0, hy: 0, dir: 1, ph: 0, st: 'go', t: 0, wait: 9 }); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code:'ArrowDown'})); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code:'ArrowDown'})); game.step(1.4); w.items.forEach(it => { it.x = w.players[0].x; it.y = w.players[0].y; it.t = 1; }); game.step(0.3); game.put(0, 6.7, 0); w.players[0].face = 1; game.step(0.4); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code:'Space'})); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code:'Space'})); w.critters.push({ id: 804, k: 'walk', x: 6.2, y: 0, hy: 0, dir: 1, ph: 0, st: 'go', t: 0, wait: 0 }); game.step(0.3); w.hurry = false; w.L = Object.assign({}, w.L, { waterDelay: 0 }); w.water = -2.9; game.step(0.2); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ u: Kit.lang.untranslated(), gems: game.state().gems, lives: game.state().lives })), 200)); })()

label: rainbow bonus
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 0, 0); for (let c = 0; c < 7; c++) w.items.push({ id: 900 + c, k: 'gem', c, x: 0, y: 0.2, vy: 0, t: 1, life: 9, value: 1000, still: true }); game.step(0.3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: pause
js: game.pause(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); game.resume(); r(JSON.stringify(u)); }, 300))

label: round clear
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); game.put(0, 0, w.goalY); game.step(0.6); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: next round
js: game.step(3.2); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ u: Kit.lang.untranslated(), n: game.state().n })), 300))

label: island clear
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', round: 3, go: true }); const w = game.world(); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 0, w.goalY); game.step(0.6); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: next island
js: game.step(3.2); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ u: Kit.lang.untranslated(), n: game.state().n })), 300))

label: game over results
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.phase = 'play'; w.lives = 1; w.water = 5; game.step(3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ u: Kit.lang.untranslated(), screen: game.state().screen })), 400)); })()

label: 2P results
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'normal', players: 2, round: 2, go: true }); const w = game.world(); w.players[0].score = 4321; w.players[1].score = 1234; w.lives = 1; w.water = 5; game.step(3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ u: Kit.lang.untranslated(), screen: game.state().screen })), 400)); })()

label: won
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', round: 15, go: true }); const w = game.world(); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 0, w.goalY); game.step(5); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ u: Kit.lang.untranslated(), screen: game.state().screen, phase: game.state().phase })), 400)); })()

label: English: no Chinese anywhere
js: (() => { Kit.lang.set('en'); game.showTitle(); game.step(0.5); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { Kit.help.open(); setTimeout(() => { const cjk = (document.body.innerText + ' ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('[title],[aria-label]')].map(e => (e.title || '') + (e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')).join(' ')).match(/[\u3400-\u9fff]+/g); Kit.help.close(); r(JSON.stringify({ cjk: cjk ? [...new Set(cjk)] : [] })); }, 300); }, 300)); })()
